label: Small Fauna Micro-Prep Station
description: A high-magnification workspace for the preparation of delicate micro-vertebrate fossils.

components.description: Hand-sharpened needles held in a pin vise for manual grain-by-grain matrix removal.

components.function: Applying tiny drops of B-72 consolidant to hairline fractures.
A small beanbag or tray of fine sand used to nestle the fossil so it doesn't move during prep.

game_mechanics.magnification_zoom: Player must toggle zoom levels to see 'micro-fractures' that are invisible at 1x scale.
game_mechanics.steady_hand_meter: Precision work on small fauna requires high focus; caffeine or fatigue levels in-game could affect jitter.
